# emby_api_key (Resource)

Creates an Emby API key for a named application. Destroying this resource deletes the key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create an API key for automation tools.
resource "emby_api_key" "automation" {
  app = "terraform-automation"
}

output "automation_token" {
  value     = emby_api_key.automation.access_token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) The application name to associate with the API key.

### Read-Only

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) The generated API access token.
